description: Dessertes des parcours de bus du réseau STAR is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des dessertes des parcours de bus du réseau STAR, comprenant notamment l'ordre de la desserte. L'autorisation de montée/descente n'est pour l'instant définie que sur "vrai". Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are bus, star, desserte, parcours, arrêt. The portal shows 8,317 records. The portal shows 2017-03-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
